name: Extra Sodium Sausage
description: Upon use, immediately heals one designated ally by 20% of their Max HP plus 240 extra HP.
story:
A signature dish of Astropolis, though it's mainly served to Intellitrons and diners with exceptionally strong teeth. Some customers lack the bite force but not the audacity to try anyway, a combination that has led to no shortage of dental emergencies. Shady vendors have been known to use expired, rusted metal as ingredients, so diners are advised to eat with caution.

"That's not rust. It's chili powder. A food seller would never gamble with everyone's health."
